confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on a few travel-guide and crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures. Cappuccino and cocktail ranges come from 2026 guides, the beer figure is a 2022 Gold Coast pub price, and wine has no Gold Coast data, so its glass price is estimated from a non-Gold Coast menu and beer-relative pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of the Gold Coast market in peak season, not from live listings or accommodation searches. The RBA snapshot found by search is dated 2026-03-20 and could not be verified as the latest observation for 2026-10-16, so it should be refreshed. AUD estimates were converted to USD at that cited rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Gold Coast-specific sources where available. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a Gold Coast beachfront tourist market in July.
